title: Newport Hall of Fame and the disc from the mayor of Nice
summary: Last year George Wein gave him a first Newport Hall of Fame award among eleven musicians, and the mayor of Nice gave him a Latin disc.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: And also you received last year at the Newport Jazz Festival George Welin's Hall of Fame award.
Yeah, that was nice. That was very nice.
His first Hall of Fame award which was really a great honor to be one of 11 musicians out of all the thousands of musicians in America. It was indeed a great honor and it was a fantastic concert.

Yes, it was. It was a beautiful concert and I enjoyed it very much. And I wanted to thank George Welk. He says, 'Well, you don't have to thank me because you deserve every bit of it. You should have had it years ago.' I said, 'Well, I don't know about that. I was too young to have it years ago.' And he laughed and we all laughed. But it was
really nice and it was enjoyable.

I think that covers everything.
Only, there's one thing. They gave me a disc in Nice, France, and it's all in Latin and I can't read Latin, so -- but I'm looking for some kind of a thing where I could put it, encase it in something that it would stand up and put it on one of the shelves in my den. It's a beautiful --
It was given to him by the mayor of Nice.
Yeah, it was given by the mayor of Nice, and with the help of the mayor of New Orleans --
And, incidentally, the mayor of Nice has all your records.
Yes, and he's a jazz fan and he always did like me and he liked my work and he congratulated me, and I met his gorgeous wife, as we all know her --

Princess Grace. So it was nice.
So I think that about covers everything around and it's been real great.
